scripts.wasm: cargo build -p penumbra-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/penumbra_wasm.wasm --target web --out-dir web/src/lib/wasm
scripts.dev: bun run wasm && bun run --cwd web dev
